items.subject: Deployed coordination runtime
items.remains_unproven: The separated flag/decision/ticket/work/verification/receipt model has not executed in the deployed app/Mongo runtime.
items.why_unproven: Local focused qualifications used a shim because the current chat container lacks pymongo and the app CI execution plane still fails before normal application test execution.
items.why_unaddressed: No admitted host runtime is currently connected through Remote Desktop Commander on this account, and the GitHub runner plane remains unreliable.
items.why_concept_remains: Repository source plus shimmed semantics do not prove Mongo indexes, persistence, API routing, restart behavior or concurrent actor isolation in the deployed service.
missing_architecture: real Mongo instance and migrations/index creation

items.subject: Independent M4 assessment and receipt
items.remains_unproven: No independent document-numbered M4 assessment has been received for the v6.9 coordination changes.
items.why_unproven: The bilateral team has been asked to assess, but no assessor response/report number has yet been observed.
items.why_unaddressed: The external assessor team operates through the second account/server-team lanes and has not yet returned the required report.
items.why_concept_remains: Under the canonical rule, actor tests, commit hashes, workbook rows and tickets cannot substitute for an independent assessment receipt.
missing_architecture: critique disposition projection into IT FEEDBACK/HANDOFF

items.subject: Automatic operational flag generation
items.remains_unproven: The runtime can persist flag events, but no autonomous detector currently converts live boundary/block/gate/auth conditions into those objects.
items.why_unproven: No condition-observer or event-ingress binding was added in this round.
items.why_unaddressed: The current work corrected the data model and invariants first; live condition sources remain separate systems.
items.why_concept_remains: A manual POST /coordination/flag-event endpoint proves object creation capability, not operational detection.
missing_architecture: typed source adapters for auth/gate/boundary/block signals

items.subject: Management routing automation
items.remains_unproven: Management decisions can create departmental flag events, but no autonomous Management decision workflow or policy engine is bound.
items.why_unproven: The API accepts an explicit management decision supplied by an actor; it does not independently decide IT/HR/BOTH.
items.why_unaddressed: Management authority and policy rules have not yet been encoded as a separate decision service.
items.why_concept_remains: A first-class decision object is necessary but not sufficient for governed autonomous routing.

items.subject: Department-specific authorization
items.remains_unproven: IT and HR child flags are distinct, but the current API roles remain broad architect/operator checks.
items.why_unproven: No IT/HR/Management capability scopes are enforced at the API boundary.
items.why_unaddressed: The original app role model predates the corrected departmental workflow.
items.why_concept_remains: Separate objects without separate authority can still be manipulated by the same broad principal.

items.subject: Sheet-based incoming-email flag workflow
items.remains_unproven: The owner-required HR first workflow from incoming email to Sheet flag event and explicit API task dispatch has not been executed.
items.why_unproven: No Apps Script/Sheet implementation was modified or deployed in this round.
items.why_unaddressed: The coordination schema correction had to precede any Sheet protocol implementation to avoid encoding the wrong object equivalences.
items.why_concept_remains: Email replies, Sheet rows and API dispatches must preserve separate flag/ticket/work/verification identities.
missing_architecture: Sheet event schema for distinct object IDs

items.subject: Cross-sector dependency clearance
items.remains_unproven: Dependency flags are enforced locally, but no real cross-sector dependency graph has been loaded and cleared through independent receipts.
items.why_unproven: The local test uses synthetic dependency flags.
items.why_unaddressed: The production dependency graph across the 18 foundries has not yet been projected into the new flag-event model.
items.why_concept_remains: A dependency algorithm can be correct while the actual sector relationships remain missing or stale.

items.subject: Legacy object migration
items.remains_unproven: Existing tickets, assessment rows and historical coordination records have not been migrated into the new separated schema.
items.why_unaddressed: Historical records may conflate concepts and require evidence-aware classification rather than blind conversion.
items.why_concept_remains: Without migration, old records remain semantically ambiguous beside the new v6.9 model.
missing_architecture: mapping rules for historical ticket/result/assessment records

items.subject: Frontend/diagnostic representation
items.remains_unproven: The user/admin diagnostic surfaces do not yet visibly distinguish all new coordination object classes.
items.why_unproven: No frontend component was updated in this round for flag/decision/ticket/work/verification/receipt state.
items.why_unaddressed: The runtime object model was corrected first.
items.why_concept_remains: Operators need separate diagnostic views to avoid recreating the same conflation at the UI layer.
